map_event.title: UNOSAT Gaza Strip Comprehensive Damage Assessment - 7 November 2023
map_event.description: This map illustrates a satellite-imagery-based comprehensive damage assessment to detect damage and destruction to structures within the area of interest in the Gaza Strip, Occupied Palestinian Territory, based on an image collected on 7 November 2023 when compared to images collected on 1 May 2023, 10 May 2023, 18 September 2023, and 15 October 2023. According to satellite imagery analysis, UNOSAT identified 6,786 destroyed structures, 6,241 severely damaged structures, and 14,049 moderately damaged structures, for a total of 27,076 structures. This corresponds to around 12% of the total structures in the Gaza Strip. The areas most affected by damage are the governorates of North Gaza and Gaza. Between 15 October and 7 November, there was an increase in the number of damaged buildings by approximately 55%. From 15 October to 7 November 2023, the neighborhood of Al Qaraya al Badawiya al Maslakh in North Gaza has seen a notable increase in damage (see inset 1). This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field.
